newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Italy's Fazio says markets reacting well after G7.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Fazio says markets reacting well after G7.

text.p: Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio said markets were reacting well after the weekend meeting of finance ministers and central bankers from the Group of Seven (G7) nations in Berlin.
"The markets are reacting well, very well," Fazio told reporters here.
The G7 said they were satisfied with a bounce back in the dollar from record lows hit two years ago but went out of their way to avoid giving the currency new direction.
Fazio also said inflation was falling at a world level.
Fazio is in Basle for a monthly meeting of G10 central bank governors at the Bank for International Settlements.
